limits: This is a web UI release, not exhaustive native iOS/Android device or clinical validation.
No production patient record was edited or deleted; no real medical document or DeepSeek request was used for UI tests.
Native camera, microphone permissions, OS sharing/printing, physical keyboard and iOS rubber-band behavior were not verified.
PDF preparation/viewer shell was checked with a synthetic PDF; delivery to an external recipient was not performed.
Actual destructive operations, admin writes, all doctor workflows and OCR accuracy were not exercised end-to-end.
Figma MCP quota exhausted during follow-up reads; already fetched design context/assets remained available.
An HTTPS connection timed out once; retry returned 401 as expected. A separate bare-domain DNS lookup failed. These infrastructure observations are not resolved by this UI release.
